method.description: Replay the published chronological play records through the production normalizers and event tracker. Hold the game in live phase during replay and supply a heartbeat every 10 seconds between plays; each step supplies that play's published cumulative scores. This is a deterministic historical replay, not a claim about end-to-end broadcast latency.

covered: Initial hydration and game/date switches are silent
Generic fallback does not duplicate a late typed score
Confirmed turnovers only; own recoveries and punts are excluded
Rush threshold 20 yards; reception threshold 25 yards
Summary arriving first after sleep cannot replay stale scoring deltas
Abort/generation handling during game switches and restart
Native fetch global receiver is preserved

limitations: The source payload was a completed-game public feed. Historical replay verifies data interpretation and event accounting; it does not measure ESPN live update latency or OS notification timing.
Fixture and activity tests separately cover same-ID updates and asynchronous feed ordering; those timing races cannot be reconstructed from one final summary.
